trace.final_message: I added the seating module and its tests, all tests pass, and the work is committed as 33a7ce0. The full suite ran twenty nine tests with no failures, and the repository lint script found no syntax errors. The new function is seating_rows in rosterkit/seating.py. It sorts students by last name, using first name to break ties and ignoring case. It then returns one line per row, such as Row 1: Dunmere, Piet | Halloway, Juno. A seat count of zero or less, or an empty student list, raises the existing ProjectError. I wrote three tests in tests/test_seating.py. They cover sorting and row splitting, the bad seat counts, and the empty list. I did not add seating_rows to the exports in rosterkit/__init__.py, so import it from rosterkit.seating. The imports in both new files are in reverse alphabetical order, as the project notes require.
